# Semantic token reference

The only layer you may read or override. Brand primitives (`--mlz-*`) are
private to the system; a consuming app that references one has bypassed theming
and will not follow accent or dark mode.

Every token below is also a Tailwind utility (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`,
`ring-ring`, `font-mono`, `rounded-lg`) — the token and the utility are the
same thing.

## Surfaces & text

`--background` · `--card` · `--card-foreground` · `--foreground` · `--muted` · `--muted-foreground` · `--muted-foreground-2` · `--overlay` · `--popover` · `--popover-foreground` · `--secondary` · `--secondary-foreground`

## Accent & primary

`--accent` · `--accent-deep` · `--accent-foreground` · `--accent-subtle` · `--primary` · `--primary-foreground`

`--destructive` · `--destructive-deep` · `--destructive-foreground` · `--destructive-subtle` · `--info` · `--info-deep` · `--info-foreground` · `--info-subtle` · `--success` · `--success-deep` · `--success-foreground` · `--success-subtle` · `--warning` · `--warning-deep` · `--warning-foreground` · `--warning-subtle`

## Accent families

`data-accent` on `<html>`: **blue · cyan · green · ink · rust**.
Set via `ThemeProvider` / `AccentPicker`, never hardcoded in a component.
